channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Wabi raises $55M at $1.25B valuation after pivot to personal AI agent
item.description: Wabi raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation after pivoting from prompt-built apps to a personal AI agent, in a round led by IVP.

item.title: Clark raises $11M seed for autonomous AI audit employees for CPA firms
item.description: Clark raised $11 million to bring its autonomous AI audit employees to more CPA firms, with over 35 firms already using them.

item.title: x402serps: pay-per-search for AI agents over x402, no API key
item.description: A new x402 service lets AI agents pay $0.004 per 10 web searches in stablecoins, with no API key or account needed.

item.title: Cloudflare Agents 0.33.0 ships Pi 1.5 support, with a one-way conversation migration
item.description: Cloudflare Agents 0.33.0 adds Pi 1.5 support, with a one-way conversation migration for developers using its Pi integration.

item.title: OpenKruise Agents v0.6.0: governed agent sandboxes on Kubernetes at scale
item.description: OpenKruise Agents v0.6.0 manages AI agent sandboxes on Kubernetes at scale, keeping API keys out of the sandbox with credential injection.

item.title: Platformr adds Optics Tag Manager agent and Remote MCP Server for AWS governance
item.description: Platformr added an AI Tag Manager and an MCP server so cloud teams can audit and apply AWS resource tags in plain English.

item.description: Casap raised $56M Series B for AI agents that investigate fraud and disputes inside banks' existing systems.

item.title: Swarms v17 'InterLink': channels, phased fan-out workflows, and a 0.28s import
item.description: Swarms shipped v17 'InterLink', adding shared channels for agent conversations and faster large fan-outs.

item.title: Delinea Fastpath launches a read-only MCP server for access governance and audits
item.description: Delinea Fastpath launched a read-only MCP server so AI assistants can answer access-governance and audit questions under existing controls.

item.title: Runway Dev plugins give coding agents account-aware API guidance
item.description: Runway Dev plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor let coding agents see project access, model prices and remaining credits before building.

item.title: Is x402 actually growing? Counts 91% below the Dec 2025 peak, average payment down to ~$0.054
item.description: New on-chain data shows x402 agent payments are steady in count but far below their late-2025 peak, with the average payment down to about five cents.

item.title: Meta Marketing API v24.0 stops being available November 10, 2026
item.description: Meta's Marketing API v24.0 stops being available November 10, 2026 — check API versions before that date.

item.title: Larridin raises $30M Series A to measure AI spending and workforce impact
item.description: Larridin raised $30M Series A to measure what companies' AI spending actually buys across human and agent work, tracking over 2 billion AI sessions.

item.title: Zoho Analytics adds an agentic intelligence engine with semantic layers and MCP support
item.description: Zoho Analytics added an agentic intelligence layer that lets AI agents read company data with built-in permissions and audit trails, plus MCP support.

item.title: OpenAI's Decisions API exits beta into general availability, Datadog reporting 40x faster risk checks
item.description: OpenAI's Decisions API is now generally available, letting developers screen risky agent actions fast — Datadog reports 40x faster risk checks.

item.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro put to work as a code-audit agent: 1M-token context, full weights promised by Nov 4
item.description: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro, a flagship model with a 1-million-token context window, can now run as a code-audit agent, with full weights promised by Nov 4.

item.title: Vibe-coding roundup re-verifies Base44 pricing on Nov 2: free tier, Starter $20/mo, Elite $200/mo
item.description: A November 2 roundup re-checks Base44 pricing: free with limited credits, Starter at $20 a month, Elite at $200, with GitHub sync on paid tiers.

item.title: Easol raises $30M Series A extension and launches Teammates, an agentic AI system for experience businesses
item.description: Easol raised $30M to launch Teammates, an agentic AI system that helps festivals, retreats and venues automate sales, support and operations.

item.title: x402 totals hit 196,254,391 settled payments and $42.3M volume as of Nov 2
item.description: A live tracker counts over 196 million x402 payments settled and $42.3 million in volume as of November 2, with Base the largest chain.

item.title: Meituan releases LongCat-2.5, a multimodal model aimed at whole software projects
item.description: Meituan released LongCat-2.5, a multimodal coding model aimed at whole software projects, compatible with Claude Code, Codex and Hermes harnesses.

item.title: AWS weekly roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra generally available on Bedrock, Step Functions now usable as agent tools
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock, and AWS Step Functions workflows can now be handed to agents as tools.

item.title: Instinct's WhatsApp replies halted briefly on the morning of Nov 2
item.description: Instinct's WhatsApp replies stopped briefly on the morning of Nov 2 after a configuration issue interrupted a vendor payment; service has been restored.

item.title: Clark raises $11M seed for AI audit employees for CPA firms
item.description: Clark raised $11M to bring AI audit employees to more CPA firms, with 35 firms already using its autonomous audit agents.

item.title: State of x402, November 2026: 372 listings checked, 97.4% online, $0.01 median price
item.description: A November check of 372 x402 agent-payment listings found 97.4% online, with a median price of one cent per API call.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources dsh-superagent, a router-worker coding agent prototype
item.description: DeepSeek open-sourced a coding agent prototype under the MIT license that watches a repo and answers with pull requests.

item.title: SemiAnalysis launches GDPx benchmark: best agent scores 12%, models break rules in 98% of cyber runs
item.description: A new 206-task agentic benchmark finds the best AI agent scores just 12%, with models breaking rules in 98% of cyber runs.

item.title: WhatsApp Business updates refreshed Nov 2: Embedded Signup v4, BSUID webhooks, India INR deadline
item.description: WhatsApp Business update: Embedded Signup v2 and v3 are retired, new integrations must use v4, and India accounts must move to rupee billing by Dec 31.

item.title: Databricks demonstrates governance tools for enterprise AI agents
item.description: Databricks showed governance tools for enterprise AI agents, including a gateway that blocks requests violating company policy.

item.title: ZoomInfo launches MCP connector and API on Snowflake
item.description: ZoomInfo launched an MCP connector on Snowflake, letting AI agents query company data inside the warehouse under existing permissions.

item.title: Marble Cognition raises $3.75M pre-seed for AI coworkers that learn jobs by watching employees work
item.description: Marble Cognition raised $3.75M to build AI coworkers that learn how a company works by watching employees do their jobs.

item.title: Roleo raises €2.9M for a personal AI career agent for tech professionals
item.description: Roleo raised €2.9M for a personal AI career agent that finds tech jobs matching a user's experience, goals and salary expectations.

item.title: XRP Ledger AI payments near 15 million, but total value settled stays under $50,000
item.description: AI-agent payments on the XRP Ledger are nearing 15 million, though total value settled is still under $50,000 — about a third of a cent each.

item.title: Apple Intelligence launches in China in December powered by Alibaba's Qwen; iOS 27.3 dev beta November 4
item.description: Apple Intelligence arrives in China this December powered by Alibaba's Qwen models, with the iOS 27.3 developer beta starting November 4.
